Product Listing
Topographic, thematic maps and town maps of Sarawak. These maps are classified into Restricted and Unrestricted maps, and are available for general information and usage by Government agencies, statutory bodies and the general public, upon application. Requests for the supply of these restricted maps and aerial photographs are subject to the prior approval of the Commissioner of Police. However, requests for the supply of other unrestricted maps are not subject to security clearance and can be purchased online or directly from all Sale Counters at all Lands and Surveys Divisional Offices and the Cartographic Section at the Land and Survey Headquarters, Kuching.
